name: No documented UBO procedure for foreign legal entities
description: No process for unwinding ownership beyond first-tier shareholders.

name: No EDD for foreign / high-risk-jurisdiction buyers
description: Foreign and high-risk-jurisdiction buyers handled identically to domestic.

name: No cash-deposit threshold policy
description: No documented threshold or refusal protocol for cash at contract.

name: No PEP screening at onboarding
description: Buyers and sellers not screened against PEP / sanctions / adverse-media at onboarding.

name: No UBO-level screening
description: Only contracting party screened; underlying owners not.

name: No adverse-media check
description: No periodic adverse-media check to surface nominees / fronts.

name: No structured SoF / SoW evidence
description: No threshold-based SoF/SoW collection or evidence catalogue.

name: No callback verification on payment changes
description: Bank-detail changes accepted by email without independent verification.

name: No secure-portal client communication
description: Client correspondence routed via unencrypted email.

name: No conflict-of-interest disclosure
description: Referral fees and commercial relationships not disclosed to clients.
